data.name: Aadhi Raat आधी रात
data.detailed_description:
You receive a call from your friend. He's injured, fight with some local politician and his goons in his home state. Yet, a simple case of "eye for an eye" escalates into something far, far bigger and more serious than you could have imagined, and now you're actively dismantling a massive conspiracy spanning all across the globe, and involving players far, far removed from the coordinated foreign mercenaries you find yourself fighting on unnamed streets forgotten by time, yet just as intimately involved in it like the empty casings your gun ejects. 

EXPLOSIVE COMBAT

Uncover the truth as you fight through hordes of enemies, mowing down hordes of hired thugs, corrupt police officers, foreign private mercenaries, machines, both large and small. With a small but powerful arsenal at your disposal, use the tools of death and destruction, shred everything in your way and become a one-man army.

POWERFUL MELEE

Kick enemies, drones, robots, mercenaries in power armor and reduce entire armies into fleshy bits. Nothing stops a man on a mission and no measure of might shall stop your advance.

GRIPPING STORY

Uncover a massive international conspiracy with many competing actors and powers with devious desires as their machinations all come to a head in one, fateful midnight - "aadhi raat" - in a thriller story inspired by the likes of Tom Clancy.

FEATURES

  • Action packed, single player first person shooter set in India

  • Fight in destructible environments and bust down doors with a kick

  • 9 unique weapons, each one more devastating than the last, all available at your disposal at all times

  • Thrilling single player story mode 

  • Huge enemy variety, from hired thugs, petty gangsters, all the way to private mercenaries armed with power armor and a huge legion of autonomous robots
